# gemini-vertex-switch

> One Gemini generateContent client that targets AI Studio or Vertex AI from config or google-genai environment variables, with validated URL parts and injectable transport Python package `trysac-gemini-vertex-switch`, import name `gemini_vertex_switch`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
